cards.question:
Prefix sum

Construct an array where each element stores the sum of all preceding elements up to that index.

Prefix maximum

Construct an array containing the maximum value seen so far.

Suffix sum

Construct an array where each element stores the sum from that index to the end.

Suffix maximum

Construct an array containing the maximum value from each position to the end.

Range sum query

Compute the sum of a subarray `[l, r]` using a prefix-sum array.
